evaluation.error: Keep the public module parameters and ports unchanged; whitespace may vary
evaluation.limitation: Synthetic faults; six finite directed/random regressions and 16/12-step two-state checks at fixed profiles. Not real-world defect discovery, all-parameter correctness or an unbounded proof. No clean RTL is read by this evaluator.

proposal.explanation: The candidate RTL contained syntax errors incompatible with Verilog 2001 (parameter keyword, localparam, wire in port declarations) and a functional bug where the write pointer was not reset during active-high synchronous reset, causing data misalignment after reset. The repaired version uses standard Verilog 2001 syntax, resets wr_ptr to 0, and maintains all required handshake, availability, ready, and ordering properties.
